denominator_reconciliation.sec_subscription_threshold: 39.9% is a contractual threshold associated with certain SBI-affiliated investors' Class C issuance, not a standalone statement of current economic ownership.
denominator_reconciliation.interpretation: The 39.9% contractual issuance threshold, SBI's 36.1% voting-rights figure and 20.5% economic-interest figure use different contractual/share-class denominators and dates. Do not treat them as the same measure or force them into one percentage without a complete cap-table bridge.

evernorth_sbi_cap_table.entity_distinction: SBI Holdings and investors affiliated with SBI Holdings are distinct from the regional SBIC East/Central/West SME investment companies. The SEC filing does not identify the SBIC regional entities as the subscribers.

note_financing.execution_status: Cash receipt verified; subsequent XRP purchase or deployment from these proceeds not established by the filing.
